name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a single 'if/whenever' rule; `blocker_moved` is only a condition, not a commanded goal, so no `Existence` is needed and the rule-only warning is valid. `RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key)` correctly captures 'carry the key then, or pick it up later' (b may come before or after `blocker_moved`), and its hard priority matches the 'have to' wording.

texts: If `blocker_moved` happens, then `has_door_key` must also happen at some time.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !blocker_moved&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u2
(u0, blocker_moved&has_door_key) -> u1
(u2, has_door_key) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u2) -> -1
(u2, has_door_key, u1) -> 1
